issue.title: Fast inspect-first video artifacts in the tmux viewer pane
issue.description: Opening a video artifact from the Agents tab inside tmux shows a useful frame in about half a second (always under 1 s) over SSH. It never garbles pane titles or lags tmux or the SASE TUI. The user can scrub frames, play motion where the topology supports it, or hand off to a native player. The fixed per-open launch tax is gone for every artifact kind.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md requests this work

issue.title: Stop launching mpv in tmux; show a still frame plus metadata
issue.description: tmux-still-hotfix: inside tmux with a kitty VO, render an ffmpeg still plus ffprobe metadata through kitten icat instead of mpv. Make missing tools non-fatal, add ffmpeg/ffprobe doctor rows, fix the Video Preview docs, and ship the pty+tmux regression probe.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md defines phase tmux-still-hotfix as one work unit

issue.title: Trim the viewer child's startup tax
issue.description: viewer-child-startup: pass the parent's resolved video config to the pane child through an env snapshot, lazy-import markdown_pdf, replace the clear subprocess with ANSI, add the child-side trace helper, and measure and fix kitten icat detection cost inside tmux.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md defines phase viewer-child-startup as one work unit

issue.title: Move tmux split and decoration off the Textual UI thread
issue.description: async-pane-launch: launch the tmux split and pane decoration in a pump-free worker with an explicit launch context and bounded tmux timeouts. Show an opening state, show a VCS-materialization progress toast, and emit parent-side open spans correlated with the child.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md defines phase async-pane-launch as one work unit

issue.title: Persistent frame, scrub-track, and storyboard cache
issue.description: video-frame-cache: add the ffmpeg-backed frame service. It does exact-frame extraction, a low-priority background scrub track, a decile storyboard composed with Pillow, and a content-digest-keyed bounded cache with atomic writes and cancellation.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md defines phase video-frame-cache as one work unit

issue.title: Inspect-first video view with scrubbing keys
issue.description: inspect-scrubber: replace the video branch with an inspect view. It shows the frame, a storyboard strip, and a status line. Keys: h/l and arrows to step, ',' and '.' for single frames, 0-9 for deciles, s for storyboard, space to play. Add a nonblocking escape-aware key reader, step coalescing, stable kitty image ids, spans, docs, and a probe extension.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md defines phase inspect-scrubber as one work unit

issue.title: Motion backends, native handoff, and audio semantics
issue.description: motion-handoff: add the backend and open_command config keys. mpv runs in-pane only where it can render, with sw-fast, a probed shm flag, and --audio=no. The o key hands off to a native or configured player. Add degraded banners and a motion_start span, update docs and config reference, and record the deferred follow-ups.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md defines phase motion-handoff as one work unit

issue.title: Cell-preview fallback for terminals without kitty graphics
issue.description: non-kitty-fallback: detect kitty-graphics capability from the terminal name, using tmux's client_termname inside tmux. Otherwise render the current frame with the existing Unicode cell renderer plus metadata, and fall back the same way when kitten icat fails.

payload.entry:
Measured before/after for viewer-child-startup:

- Config snapshot: parent now passes SASE_ARTIFACT_VIEWER_VIDEO_CONFIG JSON via split-window -e, resolved with load_merged_artifact_video_playback_config() so a stale env never self-propagates. Child load_artifact_video_playback_config() parses the snapshot first and skips load_merged_config() on a valid v1 object (plan baseline for that reload: 0.42s).
- Import: python -X importtime -c "import sase.ace.tui.graphics.viewer" after lazy markdown_pdf is 0.131s cumulative (was 0.136s); sase.attachments.markdown_pdf is absent from sys.modules. sase.ace package __init__ is still ~0.090s; left it alone (optional, not a local low-risk win).
- kitten icat inside tmux (pty with TIOCSWINSZ 120x40 / 1200x800, TERM=xterm-kitty): detect mean 0.030s, stream 0.028s, default 0.028s. Detection did not add a wait when the terminal answered. Pane viewer still passes --transfer-mode=stream inside tmux so remote sessions cannot pick file/memory and cannot fall into the 10s --detection-timeout. kitten_icat_command() default argv is unchanged.
- clear_terminal() writes ESC [H ESC [2J ESC [3J and spawns no subprocess.
- Child spans artifact_viewer.child_ready / .first_visual go through the existing TUI JSONL sink when SASE_TUI_TRACE=1; parent forwards SASE_TUI_TRACE and SASE_TUI_TRACE_PATH via -e.
